visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts in a bright classroom where a young woman in a white school uniform with a black bow tie, a white face mask, and sunglasses sits at a wooden desk writing. The camera remains static, showing her focused posture and the blank white wall behind her. (2) A male student in a white uniform shirt with a black watch writes on a piece of paper and folds it into a plane. He looks towards the side with a smirk and throws the paper plane across the classroom space. (3) The paper plane hits another girl with brown hair and glasses who is using a leopard-print handheld mirror to apply makeup. She looks startled and annoyed, waving her pink makeup brush towards the man as she speaks. (4) The male student gestures apologetically with open palms, looking towards the girl. A third girl with a yellow headband and glasses joins the scene, leaning in and pointing a pen as if participating in the verbal exchange. (5) The girl holding the mirror unfolds the paper plane to reveal handwritten Traditional Chinese characters. She looks at the note with a suspicious expression while the girl in the headband looks over her shoulder. (6) The setting transitions to a modern hotpot restaurant interior with warm, bright lighting. The male student is seen holding chopsticks, picking up a piece of cooked food from a steaming pot and smiling at the camera. (7) A montage shows various food items including thin slices of raw red meat, a plate of fresh seafood with shrimp and clams, and a large basket of mixed green vegetables, corn, and mushrooms. (8) The man is seen standing in front of a self-serve beverage and soft-serve ice cream machine, holding a cup and then a cone, laughing and looking energetic. (9) All students from the classroom are now sitting together at a hotpot table, laughing and eating. A girl with long dark hair holds up a colorful desk calendar, pointing at the illustrations on the cover.

A friendly female voice concludes with a clear, professional narration regarding a calendar promotion.
